notes.v1_09: Campfire: Remove the tent and the scattered pebbles and grass tufts, and make the ground a smoother, slightly greyer brown. Make the stones cool blue-grey with violet shadows on the side away from the fire. Keep the fire, logs, kettle and trees.
notes.v1_03: Harmonica: Make the background rings slightly lighter and crisper, as evenly spaced light and dark violet bands out to the edges. Give the silver cover a faint cool blue tint in its shadows. Keep the harmonica otherwise.
notes.v1_10: Pig & Farmer: Make the sky a clearer blue and add a few green bushes along the building's base. Remove the pebbles and make the dirt smooth and slightly greyer. Give the wooden porch and wall slightly cooler, plum-brown shadows. Keep the characters as is.
notes.v1_02: Cactus: Make the cactus a slightly deeper, natural green with a clearer dark side down the left of the trunk and arms. Turn its cast shadow on the pink floor a deeper rose-violet instead of grey. Keep the flower and backdrop.
notes.v1_05: Saloon Doors: Paint the wall and floor planks as smooth boards with only faint, sparse grain, in a slightly greyer weathered brown with cool blue-grey shadows. Make the view through the doorway a brighter blue sky with greener bushes. Keep the red frame and the doors.
notes.v1_07: Wagon: Make the background diamonds alternate slightly more clearly between light and mid blue. Make the dirt a smooth, slightly greyer tan with no pebbles. Keep the wagon as is.
notes.v1_08: Horseshoe: Make the table smooth planks with soft, faint grain and no scratches, chips or knots, in a slightly deeper, greyer brown. Make the horseshoe smooth satin metal without brush streaks, with a faint cool blue tint on its shadow side. Keep the gold nails.
notes.v1_06: Lasso: Make the background a slightly deeper blue with clearer light and dark wave bands. Draw the rope twists as soft broad bands without fibre fuzz. Keep the red bandana and the loops.
notes.v1_04: Boots: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Make the ground a smooth, even tan with no cracks or pebbles. Light the purple stripes evenly so the corners are not darkened. Keep the boots otherwise.
